notes.title: We've been getting asked this quite a bit, so here's the official response!
notes.content:
[b]Can I record footage of this game to upload onto YouTube?[/b]

Yes! We welcome anyone to record videos of and/or stream our games and share them online. You are free to include the in-game music alongside gameplay in these videos as well.

Thank you all so much for the continued support!

notes.title: SANCTUARYRPG: BLACK EDITION LEAVES EARLY ACCESS ON FRIDAY THE 13TH!
notes.content:
[b]Launch day is almost upon us! SanctuaryRPG: Black Edition will leave Early Access on February 13th![/b]

We’ve only got this far because of the support and feedback of everyone who has supported the game thus far. Thank you so much!

Our aim is to be in the top 100 selling titles on Steam on our launch day. That kind of visibility could make a very meaningful impact to the future of Black Shell Games, and the future of not only SanctuaryRPG but our all of our upcoming games as well), and so we are massing all of our efforts to get there on February 13th.

You can do a lot to support our goal and help us out! If you do even one of the things below we'll be eternally grateful.


[b]1. Tweet or Tumbl about the game on launch day.[/b]

It takes a few seconds and will help hugely. Spreading the word about our released product would mean a lot!

[b]2. Write an honest review of SanctuaryRPG: Black Edition on Steam.[/b] 

Help people get to know the finished version of the game! Upload an honest review after the Early Access box has left the page and help our finished game make a good impression on the gaming public.

[b]3. Facebook post. [/b]

If you have friends and family who play retro games, or are a member of any Facebook gaming groups who would genuinely enjoy the game, we'd love for you to share it with them!

[b]4. Stream the game on launch day, on Twitch, YouTube or Steam. [/b]

Promote the stream to your friends and followers! We’ll feature our favorites, and may even drop in to hang out if we find the time! Even just playing the game on Steam on release date will help drive awareness! 

[b]5. Paste the Steam store URL for the game into any chat windows you have open.[/b]

Let them know about the juicy potatoes that they could be missing out on!

[b]6. Yell out “SANCTUARYRPG” as loudly as possible. Then, do it again.[/b]

Don’t be alarmed if you get confused looks from anyone who may be in the vicinity.


[b]Thank you so much for the support everyone, we couldn’t have gotten here without you![/b]

notes.title: SanctuaryRPG: Black Edition is a first-person roguelike on Early Access
notes.content:
Dammit Steam.

SanctuaryRPG has been on Steam Early Access for a week. I originally missed it because, since the "Discoverability Update," Steam has been something of a pain to discover things with. This is not, however, a time for griping. SanctuaryRPG: Black Edition is out on Early Access, and if that means an expanded version of the free SanctuaryRPG, that's some very good news. 

Is that what it means? Let's find out by lifting a passage from the developer's Early Access blurb.

"The game is almost complete, but our goal is to make the game as replayable as possible. Early access will give us time to work on these features as well as expand on the game's content."

Top stuff. SanctuaryRPG is a first-person turn-based-roguelike-cum-RPG (and let's take a second to appreciate how absurd genres are now) that's rendered entirely in ASCII. It's text-driven, features a deep and complex combat system, and is also quite funny. I really enjoyed the free version, which, if you haven't played, can now be downloaded through Steam as a demo for the full(er) release.

SanctuaryRPG is currently 4/$5, albeit with a price increase planned after next year's full release.

Thanks, IndieGames.

notes.title: What makes Black Edition unique?
notes.content:
Well...

- 95% art overhaul by our staff artist, Angel Rodriguez
- More glorious music from our composer, Rafael Langoni Smith
- Thousands more lines of witty writing from Yixin Li and Dorian Karahalios
- Double the amount of class related perks
- Double the amount of selectable races
- Double the loot and gear variety in SanctuaryRPG Classic
- Double the amount of interactable zones in SanctuaryRPG Classic
- Double the amount of affixes on both monsters and items
- More side quests and diversions for you to explore
- Unique mercenaries that the player can hire to assist them in battle
- "Factions" system where players can fight for either The Resistance or The Brotherhood, opening up another series of unique quests
- "Wardrobe" system where players can equip different wardrobes to truly customize their abilities
- "Imbue" system where players can enchant weapons with powerful abilities
- Plenty of diverse mini-games where the player can engage in town activities, such as drinking and playing darts
- Even more advanced enemy AI
- Distance mechanica that keeps track of where the player is in battle in relation to enemies, allowing for much diverse combat strategies
- The ability to pick "Other" as your gender

...and many more features!
